channel.title: TradesStation: Blog
channel.description: Plain-English guides to house extensions and loft conversions in the UK: planning rules, Building Regulations, party walls, design choices and hiring builders.

item.title: Building Regulations for extensions and loft conversions

item.title: How to plan a house extension, step by step
item.description: Planning a house extension? A step-by-step guide from first ideas to sign-off: design, planning, Building Regulations, party walls, quotes and builders.

item.title: Loft conversions and planning permission: the rules
item.description: Does your loft conversion need planning permission? The permitted development rules for lofts in England: volume limits, dormers, windows and exceptions.

item.title: Loft conversion types explained
item.description: Rooflight, dormer, hip-to-gable or mansard? The main types of loft conversion explained, with what each involves and the homes they usually suit.

item.title: Party wall notices for extensions and loft conversions
item.description: When an extension or loft conversion needs a party wall notice in England and Wales: the three notice types, notice periods, replies, surveyors and awards.
